name: claude-kit
description: Claude Code skills + agents, tiered. dev-core (stack-agnostic disciplines) · react-core (React 19 / Vite skills) · agent-profiles (templates + profile-generator) · work-core (cross-role work-awareness) · mcv (coordinate several Claude Code sessions; experimental).

plugins.name: dev-core
plugins.description: Cross-cutting, stack-agnostic engineering disciplines as personas: drafter (plan → scope-tight work order for a headless agent), detective (debug discipline), inspector (intent-validation diff review), archivist (incident post-mortem), scout (reconnaissance on fresh code: connections, both sides of a seam, sightings). claude-kit's foundational tier.

plugins.name: react-core
plugins.description: React 19 / Vite SPA skills: perf, composition, audit, revamp, ux-review, dry, test-patterns, debug. Stack-agnostic across any web-React project.

plugins.name: agent-profiles
plugins.description: Templates for the implement/harden/verify/test agent quartet + a profile-generator skill that scaffolds a project-specific profile interactively.

plugins.name: work-core
plugins.description: Cross-role personal work-awareness skills: sitrep (situation report — recap + effort + open loops from local ground truth: Claude Code session logs, git, MR/PR state). The role-neutral tier of claude-kit.

plugins.name: mcv
plugins.description: Experimental, not yet tried end to end. Run several Claude Code sessions on one project while you talk to one: a coordinator session starts worker sessions, each in its own git worktree, and passes their questions and results to you. Requires the herdr terminal manager.
